content.text:
Vance Oduya doesn't look up from the departure ledger when you lean into the dock office. He's a broad, slow-moving man with a burn scar climbing out of his collar, and he runs one oil-black finger down the column of berths as if you'd asked him about the weather.

<npc>"Courier left two days back,"</npc> he says. <npc>"Unregistered skiff out of berth nine. Paid the departure tax in Ascendancy scrip — nobody pays in scrip out here unless they want to be remembered."</npc> He turns the ledger so you can read the entry: no name, a berth number, and a stamp you don't recognise.

Then he finally meets your eyes. <npc>"Asked after you, too. Wanted to know which ship you came in on."</npc>

content.text: Mira Kestrel came to the Hollow Spire looking for a missing courier. The dockmaster, Vance Oduya, told her the courier left two days ago on an unregistered skiff from berth nine, paying in Ascendancy scrip — and that the courier had asked which ship Mira came in on.
